units.source_text: 我不愿独自与老师照面。

en.t: I did not want to face the teacher alone.

units.source_text: 只要猫腰沿着色色走，对方就看不见了。

en.t: As long as I crouched down and moved along the colored areas, the other person would not be able to see me.

units.source_text: 就这样，我蹑手蹑脚地走了。

en.t: And so, I crept away on tiptoe.
